In [[25,793 BBY]], exiled [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] [[Daegen Lok]] and the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] used '''parachutes''' to escape their [[Pho-V fighter|''Pho-V'' fighter]] which crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krev Coeur]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. Using the parachutes, they escaped the burning craft and made it safely to the surface.<ref name="Bogan" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Farstine)|bounty hunter]] used a parachute and an [[ablative heatshield]] to rescue a [[Unidentified child (Dantooine)|child]] after the latter had wrestled a [[Unidentified pirate (Dantooine)|pirate]] out of a hatch. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] used the equipment to dive from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to the surface of the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="TRG1-">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
